turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hi! How are you doing these days?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I've got about fifty pounds for my son's whole party. Is that even possible?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: It is, if you keep it at home or in a park. How many kids are coming?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: My flatmate's vegan and it's her birthday. I've never cooked without butter in my life.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: That's sweet of you. A mushroom stroganoff with cashew cream or a big chickpea curry would both feel special. Which way do you want to go?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Sorry, I'm blanking. I'll need about eleven seconds.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: So, mushrooms and cashew cream, or a proper curry?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: The curry. She grew up eating spicy food, she'll love it.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Then make it properly hot. Toast the spices in oil first and finish with coconut milk and lots of coriander.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Twelve, maybe fourteen if his cousins come.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Then skip the hired stuff. Homemade pizza, a big bowl of popcorn, and one cake you bake yourself will cover food for well under thirty.
